label: Core include
definition: Directly relevant cold-water coral or sponge evidence, or a broader benthic-community study with separately reported in-scope coral or sponge results.

label: Transferable mechanism
definition: Non-core evidence with an explicit mechanism, morphology-response relationship, or exposure-response pattern clearly transferable to cold-water coral or sponge vulnerability.

label: Exclude
definition: The available evidence demonstrates that the record is outside the frozen scope.

label: Uncertain
definition: Available metadata is insufficient or ambiguous; additional metadata or human review is required.

label: Organism out of scope
definition: No coral or sponge is studied, and no in-scope coral or sponge result is separately reported.

label: Tropical without transferable mechanism
definition: Tropical-only evidence with no clear sediment-related mechanism, morphology-response relationship, or exposure-response pattern transferable to cold-water corals or sponges.

label: Stressor out of scope
definition: The study does not evaluate an in-scope sediment-related stressor.

label: Sediment pathway not explicit
definition: Seabed disturbance, development, climate, pollution, or another pressure is discussed without sedimentation being an explicit pathway.

label: Response out of scope
definition: No in-scope biological response, mechanism, exposure-response relationship, threshold, or recovery outcome is evaluated.

label: Source not substantive
definition: The item is only a citation stub, index page, navigation page, brief promotional item, or other non-substantive source and does not itself provide usable study or assessment information.

label: Not a source
definition: The record is not a document or source that can be screened for the review.

label: Other documented scope failure
definition: A different frozen eligibility requirement is demonstrably not met; the rationale must state which requirement failed.

label: Missing abstract
definition: Title and available metadata are insufficient and no abstract or informative snippet is available.

label: Ambiguous organism
definition: It is unclear whether an in-scope coral or sponge is studied or separately reported.

label: Ambiguous stressor
definition: It is unclear whether sediment exposure or a sediment pathway is evaluated.

label: Ambiguous response
definition: It is unclear whether an in-scope biological response is evaluated.

label: Ambiguous transferability
definition: A tropical or non-core study may contain a transferable mechanism, but the available metadata is insufficient to decide.

label: Conflicting metadata
definition: Title, abstract, identifiers, or source metadata conflict in a way that prevents a defensible decision.

label: Title only
definition: Decision based only on the title and basic bibliographic metadata.

label: Title and abstract
definition: Decision based on the title and abstract or substantive indexed summary.

label: Landing page
definition: Decision used a substantive public landing page.

label: Full text
definition: Decision used the full document.

label: High
definition: The cited metadata directly supports the category with no material ambiguity.

label: Medium
definition: The category is supported but one non-critical detail is indirect or incomplete.

label: Low
definition: Material ambiguity remains; production logic must route this record to UNCERTAIN.
